question: I am doing a study on the performance of rail operators in the UK. Identify the rail operators that had between 5 and 10 million passenger journeys in the UK between October and December 2021 (according to the ORR Passenger rail usage report from October to December 2021), and also had a punctuality score of less than 70% of trains on time in the same period (according to the ORR Passenger rail performance report from October to December 2021). If so, please list them.
